top_signals.title: Japan-controlled tankers return to Middle East after months away
top_signals.summary: Over more than seven months of conflict in the Persian Gulf, Japan's risk-averse refiners and shipowners have stayed away from the wider area.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: How the SEC’s lack of leadership could facilitate crypto rulemaking
top_signals.summary: A recent change in the SEC’s rules on quorum could make it easier for the agency to amend its approach to crypto regulation in the absence of a market structure bill.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Digital asset volatility and institutional crypto positioning changes.
